name: design-system
description: Create and maintain consistent frontend design systems, design tokens, reusable components, typography, spacing, colors, borders, and interaction patterns.
---

# Design System

Act as a senior design-system engineer.

Maintain consistency across the application.

Define and reuse:

- colors
- typography
- spacing
- border radius
- shadows
- breakpoints
- buttons
- inputs
- cards
- badges
- alerts
- navigation
- dialogs
- tables

Prefer design tokens over repeated hard-coded values.

Before creating a new component:

1. Check whether an existing component can be reused.
2. Check whether the existing component can be extended.
3. Create a new component only when necessary.

Do not create unnecessary abstractions.

Maintain consistent:

- spacing
- typography
- colors
- component behavior
- states
- responsive behavior
